method: Default weights and filters, novelty off. A local place's score is its best cell within ±5 cells (~±50 km) of the coordinates given; the percentile is among all of Earth's land cells for that target. 'Region best' is the top cell inside the bbox.

places.name: Tankwa Karoo
places.why: Hyper-arid succulent Karoo basin; often called South Africa's most Mars-like landscape.

places.name: Richtersveld
places.why: Rugged, mountainous desert on the Orange River with sparse rainfall and fog.

places.name: Central Namib (Gobabeb)
places.why: One of the oldest deserts, with gravel plains and dune seas; a studied Mars dune and microbial analog.

places.name: Central Kalahari
places.why: Semi-arid sand basin; large, flat and remote.

places.name: Vredefort impact structure
places.why: The largest verified impact structure on Earth (~2 Ga); an impact-geology analog, now deeply eroded.

places.name: Karoo dolerites (Valley of Desolation)
places.why: Jurassic dolerite sills and columns, mafic igneous rock like lunar and Martian basalt.
